build_openai_model_registry: build an OpenAIModelRegistry to provide a read-only view of loaded base models without engine dependency
check_model_exists: check if a model name exists in the OpenAI model registry and return an error response if not found
list_available_models: list all available base models with their max model length and root paths
load_lora_adapter: load a LoRA adapter into the vLLM engine with a given name, path, and base model
resolve_lora_adapter: resolve and load a LoRA adapter using available resolvers by name without explicit path
